overview.en:
Skill that teaches the model to fetch a URL and read its text content via the built-in WebFetch tool — 'just look at this page' without opening a browser.

Read text from a supplied public URL without opening a browser. Preserve the original page reference and explain what could not be retrieved.

Use this plugin in a Ghast conversation with the relevant inputs or project context. The bundled workflow guides the task; any required external tools or runtime must be available in your environment.
overview.zh-CN:
读取网址中的文本内容，无需打开浏览器。

无需打开浏览器即可读取提供的公开网址文本，保留原始页面引用，并说明无法获取的内容。

在 Ghast 对话中提供相关输入或项目背景后使用本插件。随附流程会指导任务；所需外部工具或运行环境仍需在本机可用。

starterPrompts.en: Read this page and summarize its main points.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 阅读这个页面并总结要点。

starterPrompts.en: Extract the relevant sections from this URL for my question.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 从这个网址提取与我的问题相关的段落。

starterPrompts.en: Compare the text on these two public pages.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 比较这两个公开页面的文本。
